title: Validate collaboration cache entries
responsibility: Key cached bytes by validated project and source identity and discard entries that fail integrity checks.

inputs.name: cacheKey.identity
inputs.description: Strict identity parsed before calculating the key and comparing cached entries. It requires a UUID projectId, positive integer repositoryId, 40-character lowercase-hex source commit/tree and non-null revisions, a nullable 64-character lowercase-hex artifactHash, 1–1024-character references, and 1–200-character trimmed labels; other selector fields are nullable, unknown properties are rejected, and omitted collaborationRevision defaults to null.

inputs.name: readCache.cache
inputs.description: Asynchronous CollaborationCache adapter with get, put, and delete methods. readCache fetches by the derived key and deletes an entry only after a lookup or integrity error.

inputs.name: readCache.identity
inputs.description: Expected strict identity for key lookup and verification. It has the same UUID, positive integer, reference, lowercase-hex, label, nullability, and unknown-property limits as cacheKey.identity; omitted collaborationRevision defaults to null.

inputs.name: writeCache.cache
inputs.description: Asynchronous CollaborationCache adapter with get, put, and delete methods. writeCache stores the parsed identity, its digest, and a copy of the bytes under the derived key after the optional artifactHash check passes.

inputs.name: writeCache.identity
inputs.description: Identity bound to the stored bytes and used to derive their key. It has the same UUID, positive integer, reference, lowercase-hex, label, nullability, and unknown-property limits as cacheKey.identity; omitted collaborationRevision defaults to null.

inputs.name: writeCache.bytes
inputs.description: Uint8Array hashed for the cache entry and copied before storage. If identity.artifactHash is non-null, its SHA-256 must match or the write fails before put.

outputs.name: cacheKey
outputs.description: Lowercase 64-character hexadecimal SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON.stringify applied to the strict-schema parsed identity. An omitted collaborationRevision is normalized to null before serialization.

outputs.name: readCache
outputs.description: A copied Uint8Array resolves only when the stored identity derives the requested key and its bytes match the stored SHA-256 and any requested artifactHash; a miss or removed invalid entry resolves to null. An invalid requested identity or a cleanup rejection rejects the promise.

outputs.name: writeCache
outputs.description: Resolves with undefined after storing the parsed identity, SHA-256, and a copy of the bytes. A non-null artifactHash mismatch fails before the cache entry is written.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: The package's plain Error from fail (message 'Collaboration <code>', with a code property): invalid-input when an identity fails the strict identity schema, and cache-hash-mismatch from writeCache when a non-null artifactHash differs from SHA-256(bytes), before cache.put is called.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: readCache catches its internal corruption Error; Web Crypto or cache adapter failures may reject operations, including when readCache deletes an invalid entry.

inputs.name: cacheKey.identity
inputs.description: Strict identity parsed and serialized to derive the cache key. It has a UUID projectId, positive integer repositoryId, 40-character lowercase-hex source commit/tree and non-null revisions, nullable 64-character lowercase-hex artifactHash, 1–1024-character references, and 1–200-character trimmed labels; unknown fields are rejected and omitted collaborationRevision defaults to null.

outputs.name: cacheKey
outputs.description: Lowercase 64-character hexadecimal SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON.stringify applied to the strict-schema parsed identity. An omitted collaborationRevision is normalized to null before serialization.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects with the package's plain Error from fail, code invalid-input, when the identity fails the strict identity schema; no key is returned.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: A Web Crypto digest failure rejects the promise.

inputs.name: readCache.cache
inputs.description: Asynchronous CollaborationCache adapter with get, put, and delete methods. readCache fetches by the derived key and deletes an entry only after a lookup or integrity error.

inputs.name: readCache.identity
inputs.description: Expected strict identity for lookup and verification. It has a UUID projectId, positive integer repositoryId, 40-character lowercase-hex source commit/tree and non-null revisions, nullable 64-character lowercase-hex artifactHash, 1–1024-character references, and 1–200-character trimmed labels; unknown fields are rejected and omitted collaborationRevision defaults to null.

outputs.name: readCache
outputs.description: A copied Uint8Array resolves only when the stored identity derives the requested key and its bytes match the stored SHA-256 and any requested artifactHash; a miss or removed invalid entry resolves to null. errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects with the package's plain Error from fail, code invalid-input, when the requested identity fails the identity schema, before lookup; invalid cached identities are caught and the entry is deleted.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: A digest failure while deriving the requested key or a cache deletion rejection may reject the promise; lookup and integrity failures resolve as null when deletion succeeds.

inputs.name: writeCache.identity
inputs.description: Identity bound to the stored bytes and used to derive their key. It has a UUID projectId, positive integer repositoryId, 40-character lowercase-hex source commit/tree and non-null revisions, nullable 64-character lowercase-hex artifactHash, 1–1024-character references, and 1–200-character trimmed labels; unknown fields are rejected and omitted collaborationRevision defaults to null.

inputs.name: writeCache.bytes
inputs.description: Uint8Array hashed for the cache entry and copied before storage. If identity.artifactHash is non-null, its SHA-256 must match or the write fails before put.

outputs.name: writeCache
